checks.name: runtime_match
checks.claim: The committed record is the runtime occurrence's: the instrumented engine served the control's tokens, every attempted value acquisition was bound, the committed bytes open against the run root, and no committed value differs from the Match oracle where the oracle looked.
notes: structural_leak: oracle_compare.NO_ORACLE_FAMILY_PREFIXES (kernel-interior streams excluded from the oracle by name prefix)

checks.name: local_replay
checks.claim: A post-commitment sample of required values replays exactly from the committed bytes under the Program's relations (C2 form (A)), over the required-value manifest Q(P) of record, with every unevaluated stratum named.
notes: structural_leak: sampled_replay.EVALUATORS / NOT_YET (which families the replay can evaluate is a table by family name (the stated applicability domain))

checks.name: boundary_linkage
checks.claim: Every (engine step, request) boundary is linked: the declared prompt to the input ids at the arrival step, and each sampled id to the next step's input id (C2 ordered boundary linkage).

checks.name: checkpoint_binding
checks.claim: Every served parameter the Program names equals, by digest, the checkpoint-composed tensor of record (MAN-09), with the shards pinned by their manifest sha256.
notes: structural_leak: weights_of_record.FUSED / EXPERTS / EXPERTS_MIXTRAL (the checkpoint composition of fused / expert tensors is keyed by known parameter-name tables)

checks.name: execution_extent
checks.claim: Each request's executed prefix of record (served length; the cap on a length stop, served + LAG on an EOS stop) is derived from the declared stop rule, linked to the Match account of the same attempt, and no committed row lies past it.

checks.name: required_value_coverage
checks.claim: Every identity of the required-value manifest Q(P) has exactly one committed binding, every required value class was acquired, and the manifest used is the one rebuilt from this attempt's Program x workload.
notes: structural_leak: required_manifest.members_for (a Program family is INTERIOR because the vocabulary names no member for it -- by name, F-r19-int-20)

checks.name: program_source_identity
checks.claim: The committed identities are the Program of record's: every step's committed identity set matches the expected manifest (X-03: modules, one attention row per layer, one sampled-ids tensor, the same multiset every step) and the binding map was built for this Program, layout and run roots.
notes: structural_leak: native_host.ACQUIRE_CLASSES (the expected module set is selected by module class name, not by the Program)

checks.name: runtime_match/tokens_equal
checks.claim: The instrumented engine served exactly the control engine's token ids for every request.

checks.name: runtime_match/reference_integrity
checks.claim: Every value acquisition the collector attempted was bound (attempted == committed, both > 0).

checks.name: runtime_match/fa2_zero_rows
checks.claim: No attention hidden-value row was bound as all-zero bytes (the tap was staged before it was zeroed).

checks.name: runtime_match/collector_errors
checks.claim: No collector, arena or hook error was recorded during the instrumented run.

checks.name: runtime_match/openings
checks.claim: Every challenge-drawn opening of the committed bytes verified against the run root, and at least min_openings were drawn (C3).

checks.name: runtime_match/openings_after_release
checks.claim: After the raw device staging was released, every opening (the challenge's and every pick the in-run stages deferred to replay) verified against the ORIGINAL roots, the replay reproduced the run root, and no raw byte stayed on the device.
checks.rule: R13 P0 / R17-5 openings after release

checks.name: runtime_match/openings_population
checks.claim: Every opening drawn from the required-value population had a binding and verified (BIND-01 (3); retain=none: the deferred share opens by replay).

checks.name: runtime_match/bounded_staging
checks.claim: A bounded-staging record run carries no learned-only step and was not finalized in learn-only mode.

checks.name: runtime_match/oracle_compare
checks.claim: No committed value differs from the Match oracle's (form (B): the Match capture's instance-output snapshots and sampled ids of the same attempt) where the oracle looked; scope states how much it looked at.

scope.method: sampled-exact-replay(complete) + boundary-linkage + oracle-compare(partial) + offline-suite (tests/commit/test_binding_negatives.py: late-read, relabel)

notes: form (B) attribution-complete: attribution-complete: no fold instance of this op at this step x64
structural_leak: oracle_compare.NO_ORACLE_FAMILY_PREFIXES (kernel-interior streams excluded from the oracle by name prefix)

checks.name: runtime_match/compiled_check
checks.claim: Under compiled acquisition every kernel launch replays exactly and the compiled ring refused / mis-shaped no acquisition (S3).

checks.name: local_replay/sampled_replay
checks.claim: A post-commitment stratified sample of required values replays exactly (bit-for-bit) from the committed bytes under the Program's registered relations.
notes: structural_leak: sampled_replay.EVALUATORS / NOT_YET (which families the replay can evaluate is a table by family name (the stated applicability domain))

checks.name: local_replay/seed_of_record
checks.claim: The replay's seed is post-commitment as a FACT: recomputed from the run root (or the recorded verifier challenge), never prover-chosen.

checks.name: local_replay/population_gaps
checks.claim: Every VU the replay left unevaluated is named under a class form (B) covers, and form (B) is complete over the values where it must stand in; plane-fed VUs never pass by name.

checks.name: local_replay/population_scope
checks.claim: The replay's population is the required-value manifest Q(P) of record, reconciled identity by identity (reach + uncovered-by-name == |Q(P)|; engines agree).
notes: C2 population scope (R17-3; query of record Q_module_body_v1): Q_module_body_v1(P) = 7043 identities (fa2_hidden_m1_stream 512, input_token_ids 32, instance_outputs 6240, sampled_token_ids 32, sampler_seed 32, sampler_splits 32, weights 163; guard state not on the manifest (pre-R17 header); no cross-check on the manifest (one engine asked for by name: inventory)); exact replay reaches 6272 (89.1%), under an evaluated module 1480; uncovered by name: fa2_hidden_m1_stream x512 (mechanism), input_token_ids x32 (mechanism), sampler_seed x32 (mechanism), sampler_splits x32 (mechanism), weights x163 (mechanism)

checks.name: local_replay/attribution
checks.claim: At B >= 2 the per-(step, request) attribution of every committed value is verified by a complete form (B); else the gap is named on the PASS.

checks.name: boundary_linkage/ordered_linkage
checks.claim: Every (engine step, request) boundary is linked: declared prompt -> input ids at the arrival step; sampled id[s-1] -> input id[s]; none unlinked.

seed.rule: committed runner.sampler/seed word == the DECLARED workload seed of the request (i64 exact) at every step with a committed sampled id (constant per request; stoch M-0446)

splits.rule: committed runner.sampler/splits word at step s == SplitsFor_v1(#requests with a committed sampled id at s, num_SMs of record) (REQ-03 derived S)

checks.name: checkpoint_binding/weights_of_record
checks.claim: Every served parameter the Program names equals by digest the checkpoint-composed tensor of record; every shard is pinned by its manifest sha256.
notes: structural_leak: weights_of_record.FUSED / EXPERTS / EXPERTS_MIXTRAL (the checkpoint composition of fused / expert tensors is keyed by known parameter-name tables)

checks.name: execution_extent/executed_prefix_of_record
checks.claim: Each request's executed prefix is the cap on a length stop, or served + the Program's declared LAG on an EOS stop whose last served token is a declared EOS id; never defaulted.

checks.name: execution_extent/match_account_link
checks.claim: The Commit's served lengths equal the Match record's (tokens.json) and GM-01's G6 account of the same attempt, and the LAG is attested on every leg.

checks.name: execution_extent/rows_past_the_stop
checks.claim: No committed row lies at a position >= a request's executed prefix (execution past the stop).

checks.name: required_value_coverage/identity_coverage
